errors.text_span: 横轴表示模型序号或投票轮次
errors.evidence: The x-axis does not have a label in the figure. The description hallucinates the label "模型序号或投票轮次" (model serial number or voting round).
The x-axis does not have units specified in the figure. The description hallucinates the unit "无量纲序号" (dimensionless serial number).
The y-axis does not have a label in the figure. The description hallucinates the label "伪误报率（FP）" (false positive rate (FP)).
The y-axis does not have units specified in the figure. The description hallucinates the unit "无量纲FP值" (dimensionless FP value).
The starting value of the solid line at x=1 is visibly higher than 2600, approximately 2650.
The description incorrectly identifies the location of the minimum point. The lowest point of 2000 occurs at x=13, not x=15. At x=15, the value is approximately 2500.
The ending value of the solid line at x=30 is visibly higher than 2500, approximately 2580.
